newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung Elec says wins $150 mln order.
newsitem.headline: Samsung Elec says wins $150 mln order.

text.p: Samsung Electronics Co, a unit of South Korea's Samsung Group, said on Monday it had won a $150 million contract to provide digital video disc (DVD) players to Nanshen, a Hong Kong-based distribution company.
A Samsung statement said the 300,000 DVD players would be supplied between early 1997 and end of 1998.
"The majority of DVD players will be supplied to China through Nanshen," a company spokesman said.
Samsung also plans to increase exports of DVD players to China, North America, Europe and Southeast Asia, the statement said. It gave no further details.
